destination.name: South Gippsland
destination.tagline: Prom Country's wild coast, Strzelecki rainforest and coal-mining heritage
destination.description: South Gippsland, also known as Prom Country, takes in the southernmost point of the Australian mainland. Its draws range from coastal parks and beaches to mountain rainforest and maritime and coal-mining heritage. The State Coal Mine at Wonthaggi worked from 1910 to 1968 and is now a Parks Victoria heritage area with a cafe. The Prom Country Information Centre at Korumburra is about 90 minutes' drive from Melbourne.
whyVisit: Walk wild coastal parks and beaches
Cycle the Great Southern Rail Trail

goodToKnow.title: Drive, don't rely on buses
goodToKnow.detail: V/Line's daily bus runs only from Melbourne to Yarram, so reaching the coastal parks and towns is realistic only by car.

goodToKnow.title: Stop at the info centre
goodToKnow.detail: The Prom Country Information Centre on the South Gippsland Highway at Korumburra is the region's main visitor centre.
